name: GitHub Copilot CLI
description: Adds GitHub Copilot CLI (measured on 1.0.91) as a backend the launcher can spawn. Its lifecycle hooks reach the daemon through this plugin's loopback sink; it installs no config or hooks in ~/.copilot and writes nothing to the repo.
summary: Lets you start GitHub Copilot CLI sessions from the phone and answer its permission questions there.
places: Launcher: GitHub Copilot CLI as a program a new session can run
Settings: how long a permission question waits for your tap

settings.label: Permission hold
settings.note: How long a Copilot permission request waits for a tap on the phone before Copilot shows its own dialog in the terminal. Kept below the hook's own timeout so Copilot never kills the hook.

actions.label: Forget allow rules
actions.note: Drops the rules made by tapping "don't ask again" while Copilot waited on its permission hook. They are this session's only and never outlive it.
